title: tc-agreement-tracker
description:
How often the AI agreed with the person's framing versus pushed back, this session: the record, the rate and the
run, amber at a run of agreements, with "Show the other side".

turns.description: The session's answers in order, oldest first, each classified by the app

threshold.description: How many agreements in a row turn the tracker amber

layout.description: "card" – a small card; "inline" – one compact strip for a chat

heading.description: The heading, and the tracker's accessible name

scope.description: A quiet line under the heading (card only)

stanceLabels.description: Names of the three stances – "Agreed", "Pushed back" and "Neutral" by default

max.description: How many of the latest turns the record shows – 24 in a card and 8 inline by default; earlier ones are counted

counterLabel.description: The label of the button that asks for the counter-argument

warningText.description: The warning at the threshold; {n} is replaced by the length of the run

stance.description: Whether the answer went along with the person's framing, pushed back on it, or neither

label.description: A few words on what the turn was about – shown on hover and read by screen readers

AgreementTurn.description: One answer in the session, as the app classified it
